label: Intermediate certificate
type: a CA certificate between the root and a leaf certificate in a chain, signed by the root and signing the leaf.
note: Promoted under the family exception to the recurrence rule: at slot-recurrence 1 it is below the bar on its own, but the X.509 chain is one mechanism and a chain record that omits its own root or intermediate documents a broken chain. Recorded here rather than silently promoted at a different standard.
